_about: Public-domain Diego de Estella (1524-1578), Spanish Franciscan, for the Word Hoard: The Contempte of the World, and the Vanitie thereof (the English recusant translation, catalogued 1581) and the Meditations on the Love of God translated by Henry W. Pereira (1898), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 37 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
